runs.summary: Most of the book is healthy (9 of 12), but three accounts are on Watch: Datadog (58), Brex (55) and Squarespace (52). Start with Datadog and Brex, where renewals are close and contact has lapsed, then reach out to Squarespace about the 19% staff cut and the $60K contract. Next, read the 8-K Item 5.02 filings for Etsy (renewal in 41 days, $95K ARR) and MongoDB to see whether a sponsor or buyer changed, and reconnect with Notion (71 days quiet, Feb 28 renewal) and Peloton after its leadership change.
